text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: P1 ALERT — GPU queue backlog spiked to 12.4k and autoscaler failed to resolve. Several pods in pool-gpu-A stuck in CrashLoopBackOff with driver OOM/Xid errors. Paging @oncall. Root ts 1799991234
robert_oncall: Taking this — oncall is paged, I'm looking at the dashboard now. ETA 5m
elena_eng_runtime: I'm seeing repeating kernel messages: `NVRM: Xid (13)` and `Xid (45)` across multiple nodes. Driver v520.56 was rolled out ~22:10 UTC. Suspect regression in kernel module memory handling.
elena_eng_runtime: quick log excerpt:
```
[ 1234.567890] NVRM: GPU at 0000:3b:00.0: Xid (13) GPU MR
[ 1234.567891] nv_peer_mem: nv_mem_register failed
OOM killer: task python3: out of memory
```
mike_sre: Autoscaler report: desiredReplicas=92, maxReplicas=50 (pool cap). It hit limit and started throttling enqueue -> queue grew to 18k. I tried manual scale to 80 but nodes started flapping (some failed to register with runtime).
irene_support: Customer impact: three paid customers reporting 504/timeout, tickets PG-4821/PG-4822/PG-4825. First reports at ~11:23 UTC. We're notifying them and offering retries. Posting status page update now.
raj_infra: Quick mitigation plan: 1) Temporarily lower model concurrency/batch size to reduce memory pressure. 2) Route noncritical traffic to CPU fallback model. 3) Rollback driver v520.56 -> v510.47 on a canary subset to validate. If that stabilizes, roll forward with pinned kernel config.
robert_oncall: Sounds good. Approve controlled rollback for 4 canary nodes. I'll cordon/drain them one at a time: `kubectl cordon node-xx && kubectl drain node-xx --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data` then apply driver manifest.
elena_eng_runtime: Rolling back driver on nodes node-21 node-22 node-23 node-24 now.
Command used:
```
kubectl apply -f infra/driver-rollbacks/driver-v510-rollback.yaml
kubectl rollout status ds/gpu-driver -n infra
```
incident-bot: Autoscaler noticed new capacity and attempted rescale at 1799991260 — new nodes are joining pool-gpu-A, registration logs look positive.
mike_sre: After rollback, a subset of nodes still reported OOMs but most stabilized. I quarantined 2 nodes and reprovisioned. Prometheus: queue length trending down 18k -> 3.1k over 12m.
irene_support: Status update sent to PG customers and a banner posted: "Degraded performance — using fallback routing; engineering working on restoration." Support will follow up with affected customers with ETA.
raj_infra: Finalizing: rollback complete on canaries and then full rollout paused. Autoscaler back to normal with desiredReplicas ~62 and healthyNodes 64. Follow-ups: increase pool-gpu-A maxReplicas to 100, add driver pin for controlled rollout, add liveness checks to detect Xid patterns and evict earlier. Opening ticket INFRA-6653 for postmortem and action items.
robert_oncall: Handoff to morning oncall @sarah.p — system stable for now but leave escalations enabled. If queue grows >5k re-open paging.
sarah.p: Acknowledged, I'll lead the RCA and coordinate with Optimize/Evals teams. Will schedule 1-hour postmortem and invite ENG-RUNTIME, SRE, INFRA, and SUPPORT.
